street_initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent pixel-art sprite for a dark medieval top-down RPG. Input reference image: the supplied medieval city image is ONLY a material, mood and densely attached architecture reference. Do NOT copy its isometric projection.
Create ONE complete contiguous group of THREE medieval townhouses sharing party walls, no gaps at all. 14 meters wide, 7 meters ground depth, two stories, varied roof ridge heights and differing narrow frontage widths (4m,6m,4m). Dark slate tiles, worn grey stone downstairs, restrained dark timber frame upstairs, two chimneys, tiny warm windows, a projecting hanging sign and one small aged cloth awning integrated on a shopfront. Asymmetric organically grown silhouette but continuous building mass. Three readable small doorways along the SOUTH street-facing wall. No surrounding street, yard, paving, people, separate props or backdrop.
CRITICAL PROJECTION: orthographic RPG map, viewed from high above toward NORTH, horizontal front facade bottom edge, all building left-right axes strictly horizontal, all ground-depth edges strictly vertical. NOT isometric, no diagonal ground axes, no vanishing points, no visible east or west walls. Roof is viewed from above, south facade visible as a strip below roof. Canvas landscape. Ground contact straight horizontal at bottom. Full building group visible with slight transparent margin, genuine RGBA transparency, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Precise coherent pixel clusters, muted palette, no smooth gradient or painterly blur. Lighting upper-left. This will be registered as 672px wide x approximately 480px high in game, 48px per meter. Doors approximately 90px high at that output size. Only one building group, not an asset sheet, no labels or text.
street_corrected: Edit the attached THREE ATTACHED HOUSES sprite (image 1), keeping the continuous party-wall group, muted slate/stone/timber palette, three irregular roof heights, doors and small shop awning. Change CAMERA to a much higher bird's-eye top-down RPG camera: roof planes must occupy about 72 percent of total silhouette height, the visible SOUTH front wall just the bottom 28 percent. Extend the roof depth toward the top rather than drawing tall front facades. All depth axes strictly vertical on image, all left-right axes horizontal, no isometric ground axis, no visible east/west walls. Retain varied roof ridges and dormers but simplify fine noise into deliberate crisp pixel-art clusters. Whole group has ground footprint 14m wide by8m deep. Output sprite will be672px wide by576px high; front doors should be about85px tall then. Outer edges form a continuous dense street block, no space between dwellings. A roof overhang is okay but do not add ground paving. Single complete connected building sprite, truly transparent RGBA background, no labels or text or people. Source is a reference asset to improve perspective, NOT a request to create a street scene.
wing: Generate a production-ready transparent pixel art sprite of ONE connected medieval service wing, 5 meters wide and 11 meters ground depth. Reference supplied image is only dark medieval stone, slate, timber materials and mood, NOT its diagonal isometric camera. This is for a 48px-per-meter orthogonal top-down RPG. Camera looks steeply down from SOUTH, almost overhead: the building roof takes up 80% of image height, south/front wall is only the bottom 20%. Rectangular long footprint goes STRAIGHT VERTICALLY up screen, narrow width perfectly horizontal. A long slate gable roof with ridge running straight vertically up the center, ALL parallel ground edges remain horizontal or vertical. No visible east/west side wall. Small attached lean-to roof as part of silhouette, weathered grey stone front wall at very bottom with single wooden door, little chimney at back/north end. One-story restrained noble-estate service wing, no extravagant tower. Dark desaturated grey, brown, tiny warm lantern, clean crisp pixel clusters, upper-left light. Truly transparent background. No ground plane, no trees, no people, no separate objects, no border, no writing. Whole building visible. Long vertical portrait composition. At final size about240px wide x624px tall, front door about85px tall. Use large readable planes rather than noisy speckling.
corner:
Create ONE complete transparent pixel-art asset for a dark medieval top-down RPG: an irregular attached CORNER RESIDENCE GROUP, 12 meters wide x9 meters deep. Two differently sized homes with shared party wall, noble stone residence at left with a steep hipped slate roof and small recessed arched door, a narrower timber service house at right, slightly stepped BACK from the front by half a meter, lean-to storeroom at back. No independent detached houses, no gaps, no shop counter or marketplace. A single red-brown banner, one dim warm lantern, worn grey masonry, dark charcoal roofs, muted brown timber. Use reference image1 (city) for mood and materials, reference image2 (existing street row) for sprite treatment, but make silhouette visibly DIFFERENT: hipped roof instead of three repetitive gables, low side wing, asymmetrical connected mass.
Strict orthogonal high-angle RPG projection: ground-depth edges vertical up screen, width axes horizontal, no isometric slant or perspective convergence. Roofs fill upper70% of visible shape and south/front facade bottom30%. No visible east/west wall planes. Pixel clusters clean and legible at final576px width, max624px height. Strong continuous outer mass like a real dense street block.
well: One isolated medieval courtyard well, production transparent pixel-art prop for dark orthogonal top-down RPG. Use reference only for grey stone, dark slate and old timber. Small circular grey stone well with open dark hole, two wooden posts and low pitched slate canopy, simple winch and hanging bucket. No ground paving or raised platform extending outside the object. High camera looking down from SOUTH, roof width axis perfectly horizontal and depth vertical, orthogonal not isometric, front wall as narrow bottom face. World footprint2x2meters, final sprite144px wide192px tall including projecting roof; restrained clean readable pixel clusters at that size, desaturated dark slate/stone/wood, upper-left light, no extra lights.
